title: Principles of Reiki in Life
author: Unknown
description: Principles of Reiki in Life, a brief illustrated guide to the five Reiki principles (gokai) associated with Mikao Usui, the early twentieth-century Japanese founder of Reiki healing. Each principle, traditionally introduced with 'Just for today': I will not be angry; I will not worry; I will be grateful; I will do my work honestly; I will be kind to every living thing, is presented with a short explanation of its meaning and its practical value for calmness, emotional regulation, mindfulness and harmonious relationships. The guide frames the principles as a daily ethic for embracing the essence of Reiki and living a balanced life, rather than as instruction in hands-on healing technique. No author is identified.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
